build_solver_subclass: build a Python class inheriting StandardSolver to implement custom train, valid, evaluate, and generate stages for AudioCraft
run_solver_training_loop: run the StandardSolver training loop with train, valid, evaluate, and generate stages across multiple epochs
load_checkpoint_with_best_state: load a checkpoint from a solver and optionally restore the best model state for evaluation
swap_ema_or_best_state: swap model weights to EMA or best state context for inference then restore original weights
get_eval_solver_from_sig: get an evaluation-ready solver from an experiment signature with FSDP disabled and best state loaded
